General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Half-life varies by person (3–7 hours).

📖 How to use

  1. Log each caffeinated drink with its time and mg.
  2. See your current estimated caffeine level.
  3. Enter your bedtime to estimate caffeine at sleep time.
  4. Aim for low levels by bed to protect sleep.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is caffeine half-life?

Caffeine's half-life averages about 5.5 hours: after that time, half the dose remains; after 11 hours, a quarter.

How much caffeine is in common drinks?

Espresso ~63 mg, brewed coffee ~95 mg, black tea ~47 mg, green tea ~28 mg, cola ~34 mg, energy drink ~80–160 mg.

Will caffeine affect my sleep?

Enter your usual bedtime and the tool estimates remaining caffeine then — aim for under 50 mg for easier sleep.
